nodes.label: Two-Number Versioning Strategy
nodes.rationale: Release SemVer (VERSION) and integer schema version (SCHEMA_VERSION) are decoupled on purpose so a PATCH release can never silently break data and a MAJOR release need not bump the schema.

nodes.label: Release Discipline (bump at release time)
nodes.rationale: Version bump must happen with the change, not batched later; otherwise loose feat/user-visible commits pile up and the version stops describing what shipped.

nodes.label: Upgrade-Safety Check
nodes.rationale: On every encode, code SCHEMA_VERSION is compared to the vault's; code newer auto-backs up and migrates, code older refuses to run to avoid silent downgrades.

nodes.label: Repo Is Source of Truth (not live install)
nodes.rationale: skills/ holds canonical templates; cortex install renders them into ~/.config/opencode/skills/ injecting machine-specific paths, so deployed copies drift; reasoning about the live install during design work means reasoning about stale, personalized artifacts.
nodes.norm_label: repo is source of truth (not live install)

nodes.label: Interest Registry
nodes.rationale: Emergent, adoption-weighted set of interests with no central gatekeeper — solves noise pollution without a governance bottleneck.

nodes.label: Related Scoring (tags/category/type/wiki-link graph)
nodes.rationale: related scores by shared tags, same category/type, and wiki-link graph adjacency to surface connected notes.

nodes.label: Postgres + Link Graph for Hub Vault (ADR-0001)
nodes.rationale: Chose Postgres over SQLite/Neo4j/vector DB/Elasticsearch because it is one system: link graph via recursive CTEs, full-text via tsvector/tsquery, semantic via pgvector, row-level security, and every team already knows how to operate it — no new infrastructure.
nodes.norm_label: postgres + link graph for hub vault (adr-0001)

nodes.label: Repo vs Live Install Distinction
nodes.rationale: The live install is not a checkout of the repo; git pull does nothing to it, deployed SKILL.md has machine-specific paths expanded, and patching the live install directly is overwritten on next deploy — so always edit the repo first and redeploy.

nodes.label: The Dev Loop (edit repo -> dry-run -> upgrade)
nodes.norm_label: the dev loop (edit repo -> dry-run -> upgrade)

nodes.label: Conflict Resolution (newest updated wins)
nodes.rationale: Newest updated timestamp wins; section-aware merge deferred — keeps sync simple while a per-section diff strategy is left for the future.

nodes.label: Search/Related Scoring
nodes.rationale: Weighted matches across id/aliases/tags/category/body; id & alias highest, body lowest; related weights shared tags most — deliberately simple and explainable so results are predictable.

nodes.label: Vault-Only Notes
nodes.rationale: A vault-only note can be written by the agent but never encoded back into context — enables signal filtering, a private workspace, an audit trail, and zero context cost for proactive capture.

nodes.label: Why Notes Are Skipped
nodes.rationale: Notes are silently skipped when they lack a type field, are vault-only tier, are in vault_only_types (session/log), or carry excluded tags (draft/archived).
